parameters.name: necessity
parameters.description:
The priority to fix the vulnerability. Separate multiple priorities with commas (,). Valid values:

*   `asap`: high
*   `later`: medium
*   `nntf`: low

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cs describe-node-pool-vuls --cluster-id c17e742cee942410486f237293d660000 --nodepool-id np38f32fdbc60e4a1e957ffde778460000 --necessity asap --region cn-hangzhou
